integrity: The finite matrix formulas were checked using exact rational arithmetic; analytical proofs are provided for infinite-dimensional limits. The ordinary eigenvalue spectrum is established in prior literature, and historical-priority uncertainty remains. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real 0<a<1 and one repeated Blaschke zero; fixed top singular-value ranks and bottom singular-value asymptotics as N tends to infinity. No claim of uniformity at a=0 or a=1 or of extension to arbitrary inner functions.
title: Exact singular spectra and exponential coercivity collapse for boundary model-space quotients
